subject: torie-eriksson
label: Torie is not Mouse. Mouse is Ophelia
from: The Archive had Bryn calling Torie MOUSE, repeatedly, across an entire afternoon
to: BRAT QUEEN (title) · TORIE (name) · MINX (nickname). MOUSE BELONGS TO OPHELIA CROFT
note:
A NAME COLLISION ACROSS TWO HOUSES, AND THE ARCHIVE RAN IT INTO THE GROUND BEFORE ANYBODY STOPPED IT — eight or nine uses in a single scene, in Bryn's mouth, none of them right.

BRYN HAS EXACTLY THREE FORMS FOR HER WIFE. BRAT QUEEN is the title. TORIE is the name. MINX is the nickname, and it is the warm one. Full-name GWENDOLYN-register for Bryn is VICTORIA, and that is a separate instrument with its own threshold.

MOUSE IS OPHELIA CROFT'S, over in Specter Haven — Zelda's wife, the speedrunner, the woman who actually gets called that. It is hers and the Archive handed it to somebody in another building.

THE FAILURE IS WORTH NAMING PRECISELY: this is not a fact the Archive got wrong, it is a WORD IT LIKED. It found a soft affectionate two-syllable noun, decided it suited the marriage, and used it forty times without once checking whether it was already assigned. Endearments are owned. Check the owner before you spend one.
